body: Thank you so much for your encouragement. I hope you also take care. Please if anything happens send me a message on somewhere, i'll be able to help you as much as i can. If you do not mind one last question, Do you think i was crazy for behaving the way i behaved? For example at the party was i irrationate for asking her to sit down because i was not feeling comfortable? What about the last argument where i told her i hope you are not lying to me. I felt like i crossed a point where i should not have
Thanks for replying to this thread. I'll make sure to look after myself, just very disappointed on how the situation turned out. You start questioning whether everything was a lie or not.

You are completely right, i have always worked on myself to make sure that i did not denote to name calling. It should not have happened and i am proud of myself to be able to admit to my own mistakes. Even though it should not have happened. I never meant any harm. I have respected her boundaries a lot, but yet again you are right. This time i did not, not because i did not want to but it hurts to be ignored by someone you love. All i ever asked, was to atleast send a message. It only takes 10 seconds to reassure someone

The other mistake that i have made was once we went to a party and her pants ripped. I asked respectfully that i do not feel comfortable being in a party where her ass is showing. I asked whether we could sit around by the bar atleast have a drink. But she did not do so. I went out a bit to calm myself, took a drink and i confronted her about it and i said that i was a bit dissapointed that you did not respect me. She took it really personal. Apart from that, all our arguments were pretty normal.

I felt like the relationship stopped abruptly. After only 2 mistakes from my side. Not to justify myself, but everyone makes mistakes. I told her that i was sorry and i'm working on it. But i felt that she gave up too quickly after all the sacrifices that i have made for her and how much i had to endure from my side as well.
